crossRefs.note: Eliasaph the son of Lael shall be the prince of the fathers’ house of the Gershonites.

people.name: Eliasaph
people.line: Son of Lael, leader of the Gershonite Levites

people.name: Gershon
people.line: Firstborn son of Levi; head of the Gershonite Levites.

people.name: Lael
people.line: Father of Eliasaph, a Gershonite Levite

translations.web: Eliasaph the son of Lael shall be the prince of the fathers’ house of the Gershonites.
translations.bsb: and the leader of the families of the Gershonites was Eliasaph son of Lael.
translations.kjv: And the chief of the house of the father of the Gershonites shall be Eliasaph the son of Lael.
translations.asv: And the prince of the fathers' house of the Gershonites shall be Eliasaph the son of Lael.
